settings.title: Nothing here was made in a hurry
settings.text: Every frame is cut, joined and finished by hand. The cane is woven panel by panel — no shortcuts, no staples pretending to be joinery. Just honest materials and slow, deliberate work built to be lived with for decades.

settings.heading: Designed for life, built by hand
settings.text:
Every piece at Dew's begins with a commitment to timeless design and structural integrity. Our master artisans blend traditional woodworking with modern sensibilities, so every joint is secure and every finish is flawless.

  • Solid Sheesham & mango hardwood frames
  • Mortise-and-tenon joinery, not staples
  • Hand-sanded to a smooth, silky touch

settings.heading: The art of natural cane
settings.text:
We source only the finest, sustainably harvested cane for our woven panels. Hand-woven with precision and patience, this breathable material adds organic warmth and texture to our solid-wood frames.

  • Hand-woven panel by panel
  • Uniform tension, even weave
  • Naturally breathable & lightweight

settings.title: Kiln-dried solid timber
settings.text: Sheesham and mango, dried to a stable moisture content so frames don't warp, split or creak as seasons change.

settings.title: Hand-woven natural cane
settings.text: Tight, uniform rattan webbing woven by artisans who spend decades mastering tension.

settings.title: Hand-rubbed finishes
settings.text: Natural oils and low-VOC waxes applied by hand to bring out the grain without sealing it under plastic.

settings.heading: The Dew's difference
settings.text:
What sets us apart isn't just how our furniture looks, but how it's made. We prioritise quality over speed, sourcing ethically and building responsibly.

  • Kiln-dried solid wood: premium Sheesham and mango, carefully dried to prevent warping.
  • Small-batch production: built slowly and honestly in small batches for rigorous quality control.
  • Eco-conscious finishes: natural, non-toxic blends that highlight the authentic grain.
  • Direct to your door: by cutting out middlemen, we deliver artisanal quality at an honest price.
